turn.user_message: What exactly does our IT team need?
turn.context: Automations place, turn 5 (playbook §7: one plain question first, the technical detail only if asked).

text: One question first, before any list. The answer decides what your IT team has to link.
Are your billing and your doctors’ notes in one system, or in separate ones?
chat.invite: Anything more technical can wait. Say so, and I will park it until you are ready.
chat.note: One question now. The rest can wait.
prompts: Yes, one system. Reports are separate.
